Kerala Minister Warns KSRTC Staff Over Free Ticket Irregularities

Kerala's Transport Minister has warned of action against Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) staff found issuing free bus tickets to men. The minister stated that the scheme is exclusively for women and directed officials to take strict measures against employees deviating from the policy. This warning comes after irregularities were reportedly discovered in the implementation of the free bus ticket scheme for women.
